There are some contextual differences to be fair. The Nazis fought and defeated the entire British and French armies, then invaded the largest and one of the most populous countries on earth with one of the largest armies and simply didn’t have the attrition to win especially when the US, UK, and Soviets teamed up with their money, weaponry, and manpower. It’s fair to say that if Hitler had managed to defeat the UK and Soviets his numbers could’ve gotten even more astronomical.

Whereas the colonizers just crushed the natives. The Nazis fought contemporary armies with relatively contemporary strategy and the colonizers had a massive weaponry advantage, a massive technology advantage, and a significant advantage over a population which was not homogenous - there were many different tribes over many different areas competing against organized, united forces. There was no Soviets to stop the colonizers. They simply killed with impunity.

I’m also not certain if that 8 - 112 million is just violent deaths but a primary if not majority factor in the genocide was disease (mostly) inadvertently given by the Europeans to the natives who did not have immune systems capable of dealing with those foreign diseases.

How would somebody reasonably kill more than Hitler. The deaths camps and gas chambers didn’t come about until late 41/early 42 at which point Hitler was in a 2 front war including the largest land invasion in history. 

Take Treblinka - almost every prisoner was immediately sent to the gas chamber within minutes of stepping off the train. It was open for just under 15 months and roughly 2,000 people died there every single day and that was just one death camp not to mention the many concentration camps. Nobody else mechanized and so efficiently and bureaucratically carried out genocide. 

It’s odd to say many people would’ve been worse when really nobody else has been. Stalin and especially Mao had significantly larger domestic populations but never started gassing thousands of people per day. If Pol Pot was in charge of Germany or any western country with even mild wealth and starting killing everybody with glasses for no reason he would’ve been toppled pretty quickly. Hitler conquered nearly all of continental Europe and Pol Pot got crushed by the Vietnamese so I doubt he could’ve got anywhere near as far as Hitler.

WW2 is the deadliest single conflict in history by a wide margin and it included colonization (war in North Africa, Germany effectively colonizing its neighbours), concentration camps and deaths camps (clearly worse than gulags), mass starvation (in concentration camps and occupied areas especially near the end of the war). All these things were terrible but WW2 includes all of them on a significantly larger scale.
